scope: Sealed source/notes only; no active recovery metadata, numerical payload, NumPy, provider, arithmetic operator or fixture evaluation.

dimensions.boundary: chi and W conditional outer/top restriction removes 130 scalar coordinates; WZ additionally excludes 85 interior-sheet values; t and phase keep all 3870. This is not physical matching or rank proof.

exact_rows: r_mech=p_mech(Q,V)−[P_native_prior, scatter_F(Pi_York(z))], z=(chi,W,t). Nominal old TOTAL P is comparison metadata, not simultaneously a fixed canonical target when Pi_York varies.
r_phi=q_literal(Q,w)−Q_literal_prior, with the original full weak charge profile fixed. A fixed global I0 alone is insufficient.
R=−actual native−actual EH−actual phase+once-counted fixed-canonical ordinary, on all four normal tests; separate temporal primary coefficients remain recorded.
Theta=S*{mu(KGamma_trace−3 Hbar)} using the original scalar tests and dv/R once. Hbar is fixed EPS5.

jvp.canonical: A deltaV + K deltaz = epsilon_mech, A=D_V p_mech; K=D_z p_mech−[0,scatter_F D_z Pi_York]; epsilon=P_target−p_current.
jvp.phase: Mphi deltaw + Kphi deltaz = epsilon_phi, Mphi=D_w q_literal and Kphi=D_z q_literal. Direct mechanical/phase temporal cross blocks are zero at fixed configuration.
jvp.normal: R_V deltaV + R_w deltaw + R_z deltaz = −R. Direct z reaction is chi; W/t enter through the canonical rate response. Ordinary has configuration reaction and no temporal rate response.
jvp.CMC: deltaTheta=S*{delta mu(KGamma_trace−3Hbar)+mu[delta I:KGamma+I:delta KGamma]}, delta KGamma=N deltaGamma^0_ij because deltaN=0. Phase temporal contact is exactly zero directly, but phase/configuration/normal coupling remains.
jvp.reduced_normal: [R_z−R_V A^-1 K−R_w Mphi^-1 Kphi]deltaz=−R−R_V A^-1 epsilon_mech−R_w Mphi^-1 epsilon_phi.
jvp.reduced_CMC: [Theta_z−Theta_V A^-1 K]deltaz=−Theta−Theta_V A^-1 epsilon_mech. Neither inverse nor reduced rank is presumed.

York_target: Current declared chart fixes reference Btilde, its full small cross entries, target-raising reference inverse, owned mu_ref and C_ref. Candidate geometry dependence enters lambda^-1 transport and actual h/I trace projection; it does not silently turn the saved reference operator into B(h). A genuinely candidate-dependent longitudinal operator would require its complete geometry derivative and a new declared chart.
T=lambda^-1(T_owned+C_ref+Btilde deltaW), tau=tau0+mu_ref deltat, alpha=(tau−h:T)/(h:I), Pi=T+I alpha.

deltaT=−4 delta rho T+lambda^-1 Btilde deltaW; deltaPi=deltaT+deltaI alpha+I[(delta tau−deltah:T−h:deltaT−alpha delta(h:I))/(h:I)]. delta tau=mu_ref delta t; no delta mu*t term belongs to this fixed-reference coordinate.

Actual h:Pi trace and its JVP must match tau with all construction defects retained. Both offdiagonal entries enter canonical six-slot targets; canonical scatter is original separate F/weight/hat adjoint.
C_ref and the isotropic correction can change divergence. The auxiliary old weak-TT certificate remains reference data, never acceptance of the corrected target.
CMC_trace_distinction: Total tau is not KGamma. In exact physical inverse algebra, source EH tensor gives h:Pi_EH=−mu KGamma_trace/C; total trace includes native metric momentum. Thus no t-only K or local native-elimination identity may replace the global coupled Legendre action. Serialized inverse/symmetry/contact defects stay explicit.
For conformal chi, delta mu=6 delta rho mu. Retain delta mu times the current CMC gap even if some earlier weak row passed; retain KGamma/KADM and differentiated gaps.

Independent hdot=F k is retained in all six entries. Conformal intrinsic configuration does not impose hdot=4 rhodot h. Fixed lower E0 and genuine gauge/covector/time jets define the connection representative.

interfaces.geometry_target: finite_york_geometry_target(reference,rho,rho_gradient,W_jet,t,direction,keep,label) -> target/delta_target and h/I/mu/spatialjets with reference anchor and trace defects.
interfaces.new_candidate_contact: finite_candidate_raw_action_adapter then finite_candidate_configuration_contact on fresh candidate operands; existing raw primals/paired jets are reused only after candidate authentication.
interfaces.shared_temporal: Forthcoming prepare/candidate_shared_temporal_action must use original E/F directions for mechanical action and fresh116 H with scalar S action; H already has canonical-density units, so no extra N or mu multiplier before dv/R scatter.
interfaces.normal_CMC: finite_candidate_native_EH_normal + candidate_phase_normal_stress + fixed ordinary, then finite_candidate_global_normal_CMC; geometry/current-target JVP is separate from fixed-configuration rate application.

null_and_rank_limits: Conformal Killing directions are possible kernels of a longitudinal map in principle; conditional outer/top/sheet restrictions exclude standard global rigid examples but do not prove discrete or coupled full rank. Keep all cross entries and test any claimed null with actual paired action/adjoint.

Phase constant-value shift is a field gauge, but instantaneous phi is fixed and the unknown here is its temporal rate; it is not automatically a mass-matrix null. Fresh positive H plus the scalar FE Gram can establish an implementation mass property, not the entire reduced system.

Fixed lapse/shift removes those coordinates from the preparation unknowns. Noether normal constraints do not by themselves exhibit left-null rows of the reduced E/F temporal Hessian. The frozen operator or older star surrogate cannot certify candidate rank.
minimum_new_tests: Same fresh candidate: a mixed E/F/phase direction must exercise all mechanical blocks and exact zero direct mechanical/phase temporal cross; paired action/dual-functional contacts use unchanged masks/weights.
Nonzero rho/W/t and a nonzero owned inverse/TF/C_ref defect: verify actual-trace target JVP, both cross slots, and geometry-versus-target subtraction rather than freezing TOTAL P.
Mixed configuration+rate direction with a deliberately nonzero current CMC gap: independently verify measure+trace terms, Gamma/ADM contacts, and phase direct-CMC zero.

Whole-grid canonical/phase/normal/CMC polynomial-transpose controls plus complete literal charge/domain/positive-H margins are required before implementation qualification. Physical residual gates must be independently declared; a passing construction envelope is not a zero-constraint test.

Mechanical momenta are affine in rates at fixed configuration, but finite normal reactions include rate-squared increments; phase current and finite geometry/EOS require full fresh evaluation after a trial. No accepted finite state follows from the current JVP.
